title: US versus China, the first week of a Pacific war: who runs out of missiles first (simulation)

strikes.launch_name: PLA Rocket Force brigade, Guangdong (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: Laoag airfield, northern Luzon (simulated US Typhon launcher site)
strikes.notes: Day 1, conventional strike on a launcher site (Typhon first deployed to the Philippines in 2024, A31). DF-17 range 1,500 to 2,000 km (A23). Salvo size is a simulation choice.

strikes.launch_name: PLA Rocket Force DF-26 brigade, Zhejiang (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni, Japan
strikes.notes: Day 1, conventional; Typhon was shown at Iwakuni in 2025 (A31); DF-26 range 3,000 to 4,000 km (A23).

strikes.launch_name: US B-1B bomber over the Philippine Sea (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: PLA Navy surface group, East China Sea (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Day 1, the anti-ship round; the 2023 CSIS game used up LRASM in 3 to 7 days (A18); its stock was largely untouched by the Iran war (A13).

strikes.launch_name: US guided-missile submarine, Philippine Sea (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Day 2, conventional strike on the mainland coast; one SSGN carries up to 154 Tomahawks (A15). RAND: target choice on the mainland moves the threshold (A30).

strikes.launch_name: PLA Rocket Force DF-26 brigade, Guangdong (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Day 3, conventional follow-up on the ports the US reloads at (ships cannot reload at sea, A15).

strikes.launch_name: US B-1B bomber over the Philippine Sea (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: PLA Rocket Force base, Fujian coast (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Day 5, conventional strike on mainland launchers once LRASM is gone; the 2023 game: JASSM-ER lasts about 30 days (A18).

strikes.launch_name: PLA Rocket Force DF-26 brigade, Guangdong (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: Basco airport, Batan Island, Philippines (simulated US launcher battery)
strikes.notes: Day 6, the one nuclear shot. Pentagon: DF-26 well suited to a low-yield warhead, yields probably below 10 kt (A27); 5 kt is a simulation choice, half the ceiling and about a quarter of Nagasaki. Hero strike.

model: Glasstone and Dolan scaling calibrated to NUKEMAP Hiroshima figures; flight times fitted to published ranges; all values are estimates for a labelled simulation.
